title: Surreal Japanese Oni Scene
description: A surreal painting depicts three women in traditional kimonos with elaborate floral headdresses standing in a field of flowers that melt into black drips. In the foreground, a black silhouette of a woman with a white floral updo holds a red demonic Oni mask. To the right, a glowing blue glass lantern contains a luminous blue tree, surrounded by melting blue ghost-like creatures with crowns and sad expressions. Below them, a dark mound features glowing orbs, golden rings, and beetles.
